papers.title: GENKIDAMA: Cross-Chain Rollup for Scalable Blockchain Interoperability
papers.abstractOneWord: 提出乐观跨链 rollup 桥 GENKIDAMA，用交互式挑战把 ZKP 复杂度降到常数，对象是 Cosmos/Ethereum 跨链消息。无 LLM。
papers.abstract: 跨链桥让用户能够利用多链 Web3 系统中的套利机会，但现有方案需要用大量密码学计算（例如零知识证明）生成一串证明，才能把一条链上的全部区块状态同步到另一条链，因而面临可扩展性瓶颈。由于区块链的链式结构，任一区块缺少证明都会使后续区块的有效性变得不确定。为此本文提出 GENKIDAMA：一种可扩展的跨链 rollup 桥，通过有意识的安全—效率权衡来提高效率。正常运行时，它用乐观方式把跨链交易提交到各链，而不需要在链之间频繁、昂贵地做状态同步。为阻止攻击者，各链节点可以监控系统运行，并通过交互式跨链验证机制以较低的 ZKP 需求发起挑战。因此，对 BFT、PoW 或 PoS 链，GENKIDAMA 的 ZKP 生成复杂度渐近为 O(1)，而现有工作为 O(N)，其中 N 为区块数。这一效率来自把安全保证从“永久可证明历史”放松为“有界争议窗口内可证明”。作者给出相对全量 ZKP 桥的安全界与失败模式。原型桥提供通用接口，兼容 Cosmos 与 Ethereum。评估显示，相对现有最优方案，GENKIDAMA 将跨链交易的链上开销降低 69.6%，链下开销降低 99.3%。
papers.abstractEn: Cross-chain bridges allow users to exploit the profit opportunities of multi-chain Web3 systems. However, existing solutions face scalability challenges because they require a chain of proofs generated by intensive cryptographic computations (e.g. Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP)) to synchronise all block states from one blockchain to another. The lack of proof for any block creates uncertainty about subsequent blocks' validity due to the blockchains' chain structure. Therefore, we present GENKIDAMA, a scalable cross-chain rollup bridge that achieves high efficiency via a deliberate security-efficiency tradeoff. In particular, during normal operation, we design an optimistic approach to committing cross-chain transactions to the blockchains without requiring frequent and expensive state synchronisation between blockchains. Moreover, to prevent attackers, the blockchains' nodes can monitor the system's operation and challenge the attackers through an interactive cross-chain verification mechanism with a low ZKP requirement. As a result, GENKIDAMA has a ZKP generation complexity of asymptotically O(1) for BFT, PoW or PoS blockchains, in contrast to existing works that have a complexity of O(N), where N denotes the number of blocks. This efficiency comes from relaxing the security guarantee from permanent historical provability to bounded dispute-window provability. We state the resulting security bounds and failure modes relative to full ZKP-based bridges. We implement a prototype bridge system of GENKIDAMA with a generic interface compatible with popular blockchains, including Cosmos and Ethereum. Evaluation results show GENKIDAMA significantly reduces the overhead of cross-chain transactions by 69.6% on-chain and 99.3% off-chain compared to state-of-the-art solutions.

papers.title: ABSENTIA: Detecting Broken Access Control Vulnerabilities in Web Applications
papers.abstractOneWord: 用 LLM 智能体按路由推断并证伪访问控制不变量，检测 Web 后端的越权漏洞。
papers.abstract: 失效的访问控制（授权失败）是最普遍的 Web 安全风险之一。与注入（不可信输入流入危险操作）不同，授权是一种关系：谁可以对什么采取行动，而不是数据如何流动。每个应用自己决定这种关系，因此预先写好的规则无法迁移到下一个应用。LLM 智能体可以从代码中推断该关系，但如果没有系统覆盖应用并确定检查优先级的方法，搜索就会漫无方向，访问控制缺陷也会漏检。本文提出 ABSENTIA：一套安全脚手架，把通用 LLM 智能体变成面向 Web 应用后端的系统化漏洞检测器，由维护代码的开发者与安全工程师作为审计来运行。在其指导下，智能体构建把应用路由映射到背后代码的图。随后 ABSENTIA 逐条路由做不变量证伪：推断代码本应满足的性质，若某条未被强制执行，就把该路由报告给维护者审查。作者还发布 BAC-Bench：30 条越权公告构成的基准，覆盖 25 个仓库、3 种语言、9 个框架，均发布于 2025 年或之后，经人工审计员核实，并配有修复提交，因此只有标出漏洞版本而非修复版本才能得分。ABSENTIA 召回其中 19 条，成对计分下为 17 条，LLM 校验器确认 51% 的发现。CodeQL 与 Semgrep 召回为 0，同一模型上的无结构智能体只召回 3 条。在 OWASP Benchmark 的注入类别中，ABSENTIA 在 Python 上领先专用分析器，在 Java 上仅次于 CodeQL 与 IRIS。
papers.abstractEn: Broken access control, the failure of authorization, is one of the most prevalent web security risks. Unlike injection, a flow of untrusted input into a dangerous operation, authorization is a relation: who may act on what, not how data moves. Each application decides that relation for itself, so no rule written in advance carries to the next. An LLM agent can infer it from the code, but with no systematic way to cover the application and prioritize what to inspect, its search stays undirected and access-control flaws go undetected. We present ABSENTIA, a security scaffolding that turns general LLM agents into systematic vulnerability detectors for the backend of web applications, run as an audit by the developers and security engineers who maintain the code. Under its direction, the agents build a graph that maps the application's routes to the code behind them. ABSENTIA then works route by route, applying invariant falsification: it infers the properties the code is meant to satisfy, and where one is not enforced, reports the route for maintainer review. We also release BAC-Bench, a benchmark of 30 broken access control advisories across 25 repositories, 3 languages, and 9 frameworks, each published in 2025 or later, verified by a human auditor, and paired with its fixing commit, so credit requires flagging the vulnerable version and not the fixed one. ABSENTIA recalls 19 of them, 17 under paired credit, and an LLM verifier confirms 51% of its findings. CodeQL and Semgrep recall none, and an unstructured agent on the same model recalls 3. In the OWASP Benchmark injection categories, ABSENTIA leads the dedicated analyzers in Python and trails only CodeQL and IRIS in Java.

papers.title: RAISE: Reinforcing Access Control Policy Synthesis in LLMs via Symbolic Evaluation
papers.abstractOneWord: 用形式化验证信号做监督微调与强化学习，训练 LLM 把自然语言合成可验证的 Cedar 访问控制策略。
papers.abstract: 把自然语言访问控制需求翻译成策略，需要仔细推理权限、约束与例外；即便前沿大模型也经常写出违反预期授权语义的策略。作者构建 CedarInstruct：据他们所知，这是首个同时支持训练与语义评估、面向可形式化验证的 Cedar 策略合成数据集。它包含 5800 个场景，覆盖 44 个领域，其中 1408 个刻画同一个合成组织；每个场景都有经验证的目标策略和可执行验证计划。在此数据上提出 RAISE：分两阶段用形式化验证训练策略合成器，先做经验证的监督微调（SFT），再进入从校验器信号学习的强化学习（RL）阶段。作者发现 SFT 之所以有效，很大程度上是让模型把已有的授权逻辑写出来：未训练模型很少写出合法 Cedar，但一旦写对，推理往往正确。SFT 之后，如何使用校验器信息比使用多少更重要。在六种逐步使用更丰富校验器信号的 RL 实例中，只有 RAISE-OC 相对 SFT 有实质提升：它把失败检查与符号反例变成有引导的探索，并用 off-context GRPO 从结果学习。在约 5400 个已验证场景上用 LoRA 微调后，RAISE-OC 把 Qwen3.5-9B 的语义成功率在留出场景上分别超过零样本 GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5 约 13.33 和 16.26 个百分点，且训练可迁移到独立构建的 CedarBench。
papers.abstractEn: Translating natural-language access-control requirements into policies requires careful reasoning about permissions, constraints, and exceptions, and even frontier LLMs often produce policies that violate the intended authorization semantics. We construct CedarInstruct, to our knowledge the first dataset that supports both training and semantic evaluation for formally verifiable Cedar policy synthesis. It contains 5,800 scenarios across 44 domains and 1,408 representing a single synthetic organization, each with a verified target policy and an executable verification plan. On this data we introduce RAISE, which trains policy synthesizers from formal verification in two stages, verified supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by a reinforcement learning (RL) stage that learns from verifier signal. We find that SFT succeeds largely by letting models express authorization logic they already have, since untrained models rarely write valid Cedar but often reason correctly when they do. After SFT, how the verifier's information is used matters more than how much of it is used. Of six RL instantiations that consume progressively richer verifier signal, only RAISE-OC improves meaningfully on SFT; it turns failed checks and symbolic counterexamples into guided exploration and learns from the result with off-context GRPO. With about 5.4K verified scenarios and LoRA fine-tuning, RAISE-OC trains Qwen3.5-9B to surpass zero-shot GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 by 13.33 and 16.26 percentage points in semantic success on held-out scenarios, and training transfers to the independently constructed CedarBench.

papers.title: Automatically Building Machine-Checked Assurance Cases from C Codebases to Requirements
papers.abstractOneWord: 用 LLM 辅助在 VST/Rocq 中为 C 代码库自动构造机器检查的内存安全与泄漏自由保证，含工业密码组件。
papers.abstract: 大语言模型在自动化交互式定理证明上已显示潜力，但验证真实世界的 C 代码库远不止逐个证明目标：需要同时构造有表达力的函数规约及其证明，并保证库接口沿预定调用序列可组合，即使没有指定客户端。本文提出 CCV：一个 LLM 辅助框架，用于构建机器检查的保证案例（assurance cases），即结构化、可审计的工件，用以支持“某 C 代码库满足其预期需求”的主张。为刻画开放库中跨接口的预期用法，CCV 构造接口协议，展示允许的调用序列与资源假设供审查，并在已验证契约与调用方义务下给出条件安全保证。CCV 协调两个互补阶段：（i）需求引导的分析，自底向上构造候选规约与协议；（ii）模块化证明构造，并用反馈修订规约与证明。实现基于 Rocq 中的 VST。CCV 验证了六个 C 基准中全部 299 个函数定义的内存安全与无泄漏，包括工业密码组件，每个基准报告的人力少于一人天。这些保证依赖于披露的契约与假设；人工审查提供把形式化工件连接到预期需求的符合性判断。
papers.abstractEn: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating interactive theorem proving, yet verification of real-world C codebases requires more than discharging individual proof goals. The task involves jointly constructing expressive function specifications and their proofs, and ensuring that library interfaces compose along intended call sequences even without a designated client. This paper presents CCV, an LLM-assisted framework for building machine-checked assurance cases: structured, auditable artifacts supporting the claim that a C codebase meets its intended requirements. To model intended cross-interface use in open libraries, CCV constructs an interface protocol that exposes permitted call sequences and resource assumptions for review, with a conditional safety guarantee under verified contracts and caller obligations. CCV coordinates two complementary phases: (i) requirement-guided analysis and bottom-up construction of candidate specifications and protocols; and (ii) modular proof construction with feedback that revises the specifications and proofs. Implemented using VST in Rocq, CCV verifies memory safety and leak freedom for all 299 function definitions across six C benchmarks, including industrial cryptographic components, with less than one person-day of reported human effort per benchmark. The guarantees depend on disclosed contracts and assumptions; human review supplies the conformance judgments connecting the formal artifacts to the intended requirements.

papers.title: Autonomous OSS Threat Detection via Taxonomy-Aligned LLMs
papers.abstractOneWord: 用与威胁分类法对齐的 GPT-4 提示，对开源供应链攻击事件做自动检测与分类。
papers.abstract: 开源软件（OSS）生态面临日益复杂的供应链攻击，包括拼写劫持、依赖混淆、Trojan Source 混淆、恶意构建注入以及 CI/CD 流水线投毒。现有检测方法依赖基于签名的工具和规则系统，难以泛化到攻击变体与新兴威胁模式。本文提出一种与分类法对齐的大语言模型框架，用于自动检测与分类 OSS 供应链威胁。作者引入覆盖五类攻击的结构化 AV-xxx 威胁分类法，并构建包含 999 条经核实真实事件的数据集，来源包括 GitHub Security Advisories、CISA 警报与安全研究报告，时间跨度 2018 至 2026。使用与分类法对齐的 GPT-4 提示工程，该框架在五类威胁上达到 97.0% 的多分类准确率与 97.0% 宏 F1。与五个传统机器学习基线、一个零样本开源 LLM 以及两个微调神经模型比较后发现：微调后的 Llama 3.1 8B（70.5%）与 SecRoBERTa（77.5%）都不如简单的 TF-IDF 分类器（82.3%），而未做分类法对齐的 Mistral 7B 只有 65.7%。这些结果说明，促成高分类准确率的关键因素是与分类法对齐的提示，而不是模型规模、领域预训练或微调。数据集与代码已公开，以支持可复现的供应链安全研究。
papers.abstractEn: Open source software (OSS) ecosystems face growing threats from sophisticated supply chain attacks including typosquatting, dependency confusion, Trojan Source obfuscation, malicious build injection, and CI/CD pipeline poisoning. Existing detection approaches rely on signature-based tools and rule-based systems that struggle to generalize across attack variants and emerging threat patterns. In this paper we propose a taxonomy-aligned large language model framework for automated detection and classification of OSS supply chain threats. We introduce a structured AV-xxx threat taxonomy covering five attack categories and construct a curated dataset of 999 verified real-world OSS supply chain incidents sourced from GitHub Security Advisories, CISA alerts, and security research reports spanning 2018 to 2026. Using taxonomy-aligned prompt engineering with GPT-4, our framework achieves 97.0% multi-class classification accuracy and 97.0% macro F1 score across all five threat categories. Comparative evaluation against five traditional machine learning baselines, one zero-shot open source LLM, and two fine-tuned neural models reveals a surprising finding: fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B (70.5%) and SecRoBERTa (77.5%) both underperform simple TF-IDF classifiers (82.3%), while Mistral 7B without taxonomy alignment achieves only 65.7%. These results confirm that taxonomy-aligned prompting rather than model scale, domain pretraining, or fine-tuning is the critical factor enabling high classification accuracy. Our dataset and code are publicly available to support reproducible supply chain security research.

papers.title: RANDAO Manipulation in the Presence of MEV
papers.abstractOneWord: 在含 MEV 的广义奖励模型下计算以太坊 RANDAO 操纵的近优策略，并讨论尾槽罚没。无 LLM。
papers.abstract: 以太坊的随机信标 RANDAO 众所周知可被操纵，先前工作 [AW24] 计算了策略性提议者所能提议的精确区块比例。然而区块比例只是参与者收益的代理指标。本文提出广义奖励模型，覆盖多种典型收益形式：共识奖励滚存、多区块 MEV、CEX-DEX 套利、预言机操纵等。作者给出方法，可对模型中任意奖励方案（以及上述收益的任意组合）计算 ε-最优策略。最后把该方法用于若干典型例子，说明 RANDAO 操纵对底层奖励的敏感性。若奖励部分滚存，或随连续区块超线性增长，则操纵 RANDAO 的激励会被放大。作者还研究可建模为奖励函数的尾槽罚没（tail-slot slashing），并证明诚实均衡可以恢复。
papers.abstractEn: Ethereum's randomness beacon (RANDAO) is well-known to be manipulable, and prior work [AW24] computes the precise fraction of blocks a strategic proposer can propose. The fraction of blocks proposed, however, is only a proxy for participants' rewards. We propose a generalized reward model capturing many canonical forms of rewards: consensus reward rollover, multi-block MEV, CEX-DEX arbitrage, oracle manipulation, and others. We provide a methodology that computes an ε-optimal strategy for any reward scheme in our model (and in particular, any combination of the above rewards). Finally, we apply our methodology to several canonical examples, and establish the sensitivity of RANDAO manipulation to the underlying rewards. We find that if rewards partially roll over, or scale super-linearly with consecutive blocks, the incentive to manipulate RANDAO is amplified. Lastly, we investigate tail-slot slashing, which can be modeled as a reward function, and show that honest equilibria can be recovered.

papers.title: STAKE: Preventing a colluding majority from double spending
papers.abstractOneWord: 提出质押协议 STAKE，使区块链在仅约三分之一诚实节点时仍能抑制合谋多数的双花。无 LLM。
papers.abstract: 区块链通常运行在难以控制消息延迟的开放网络中。经典协议假设同步，较新协议则试图在意外网络延迟下仍保持安全。遗憾的是，在参与者只能是诚实或拜占庭的传统模型里，需要超级多数，即 floor(2n/3)+1 个诚实节点。近期工作在博弈论模型中引入 k 个理性参与者与 t 个拜占庭参与者，有时把所需诚实节点降到多数。据作者所知，尚无区块链协议能再往下降。本文提出协议 STAKE（Secure and Tolerant Algorithm through (k,t)-robust Equilibrium），只需 floor(n/3)+1 个诚实参与者即可工作。STAKE 要求每个共识参与者质押相对其流动性 ℓ 足够大的金额 s。作者证明，联盟成功执行 ζ 次双花攻击（称为 ζ 重攻击）的概率随 ζ 多项式下降。由此可证明 STAKE 达到 (k,t)-鲁棒均衡，即理性参与者不会与拜占庭合谋，即使 s/ℓ 比较低。
papers.abstractEn: Blockchains typically operate in open networks where it is hard to control the delay of messages. While classic blockchain protocols assumed synchrony, newer protocols try to remain secure despite unexpected network delays. Unfortunately, in the traditional model where n participants can either be honest or Byzantine, we need a supermajority, or floor(2n/3)+1, of them to be honest. Recent work have explored the question of reducing the number of needed honest nodes in a game theory model to a majority sometimes by introducing k rational players and t Byzantine players. Yet, to our knowledge, no blockchain protocol managed to reduce it further. In this paper, we offer a blockchain protocol called Secure and Tolerant Algorithm through (k,t)-robust Equilibrium (STAKE) that works with only floor(n/3)+1 honest players. STAKE requires each consensus participant to stake a sufficiently large amount s compared to their liquidity ℓ. We show that the probability that a coalition manages to execute ζ double spending attacks (we call them a ζ-uple attack) drops polynomially fast with ζ. This allows us to demonstrate that STAKE reaches a (k,t)-robust equilibrium, or that rational players do not collude with Byzantine, even with a relatively low s/ℓ ratio.

papers.title: Proof-Gated Signing: Solver-Checked Transaction Guards that Hold Under State Drift for Onchain AI Agents
papers.abstractOneWord: 用 SMT 求解器检查声明式策略并编译链上后置条件，防止 AI 钱包交易在状态漂移与抢跑下被利用。无 LLM 做漏洞检测。
papers.abstract: 控制钱包的 AI 智能体会读取攻击者可达的内容，因而可能被诱导提出有害交易。常见的最后一道防线是签名前检查：静态白名单、LLM 审查者或交易模拟。三者有共同缺口：检查描述的是检查时刻的链状态，而交易执行发生在更晚、可被对手通过抢跑、合约升级或代币参数变更来塑造的状态。作者称之为状态漂移（state drift）。本文提出 Proof-Gated Signing（PGS）：模拟拟议交易、抽取其效果，并用 SMT 求解器在预言机不确定区间内的每个价格上检查声明式的价值与权限策略。随后编译链上后置条件（钱包余额界、收款回执、授权上限与所有权），并证明满足这些条件的每次执行也满足该策略。智能体的智能合约钱包原子地强制执行它们，因此保证适用于任意漂移下实际执行的交易。在含 260 个场景的开放测试床上（14 个攻击族，含 5 个漂移族与 2 个自适应族，以及 12 个良性族），危害以攻击者余额而非任何策略度量：PGS 阻止了 140 个有害场景中的 93.6%，并通过 97.5% 的良性场景。仅模拟检查阻止 57.9%，静态白名单 71.4%。50 个漂移场景在 PGS 下均未产生攻击者收益。唯一未阻止的族是策略内抽干，被每会话预算封顶。作者还发现，给 LLM 审查者一份干净的漂移前模拟，反而更可能让它批准漂移攻击。开销约为 41k gas 与每次检查 0.1–0.2 秒。
papers.abstractEn: AI agents that control wallets read attacker-reachable content, so they can be steered into proposing harmful transactions. The usual last line of defense is a pre-signing check: a static allowlist, an LLM reviewer, or a transaction simulation. All three share a gap: the check describes the chain state at check time, but the transaction executes in a later state that an adversary can shape through front-running, contract upgrades or token-parameter changes. We call this state drift. We present Proof-Gated Signing (PGS), which simulates a proposed transaction, extracts its effects, and uses an SMT solver to check a declarative value-and-permission policy for every price in an oracle-uncertainty band. It then compiles on-chain post-conditions (wallet balance bounds, payee receipts, allowance caps and ownership) and proves that every execution satisfying them also satisfies the policy. The agent's smart-contract wallet enforces them atomically, so the guarantee applies to the executed transaction under arbitrary drift. On an open testbed of 260 scenarios (14 attack families including five drift and two adaptive families, and 12 benign families), with harm measured from attacker balances rather than from any policy, PGS prevented 93.6% of the 140 harmful scenarios and passed 97.5% of the benign ones. Simulation-only checking prevented 57.9% and a static allowlist 71.4%. None of the 50 drift scenarios produced attacker gain under PGS. The only unprevented family, an in-policy drain, was bounded by the per-session budget. We also find that giving an LLM reviewer a clean pre-drift simulation made it more likely to approve a drift attack. Overhead is about 41k gas and 0.1-0.2 s per check.

papers.title: Seamless Reconfiguration for DAG-BFT
papers.abstractOneWord: 为异步 DAG-BFT 提出无停机成员变更协议，使 DAG 在法定人数切换时继续增长。无 LLM。
papers.abstract: 异步网络中的拜占庭原子广播已研究数十年。FLP 不可能结果排除了完全异步下的确定性共识，从而促使随机化协议把可靠广播与私有硬币结合，以概率 1 终止。近来 DAG-Rider 推广了一种新抽象：进程持续可靠广播区块以构造有向无环图（DAG），再用随机完美硬币在本地导出全序。这种把传播与排序分离的做法重新激发了对异步 DAG 拜占庭容错的兴趣，并催生许多改进期望延迟或吞吐的协议。但重配置几乎未被探索。现有 DAG-BFT 协议通常假设进程集合静态，而部署系统必须按运维需求偶尔增删节点。现有方案并不无缝：要么暂停系统，要么把成员变更推迟到预定纪元边界，可能不切实际并引入停机。无缝方案也非平凡：就“何时开始使用新配置”达成一致，可能得到一个已被并发异步传播越过的逻辑轮次号。本文提出面向异步 DAG 拜占庭原子广播的无缝重配置协议，允许 DAG 在成员集合与相应法定人数阈值变化时继续增长，而不停止系统。据作者所知，这是第一个在完全异步网络中为 DAG 拜占庭原子广播提供无缝重配置的协议。
papers.abstractEn: Byzantine Atomic Broadcast in Asynchronous networks has been studied extensively for decades. The FLP impossibility result rules out deterministic consensus in a fully asynchronous setting, motivating randomized protocols that combine reliable broadcast with private coins to achieve termination with probability one. More recently, DAG-Rider popularized a new abstraction in which processes continuously reliably broadcast blocks to construct a directed acyclic graph (DAG) and then locally derive a total order using a randomized perfect coin. This separation of dissemination from ordering has renewed interest in asynchronous DAG-based Byzantine fault tolerance and inspired numerous protocols that improve expected latency or throughput. Reconfiguration, however, remains largely unexplored. Existing DAG-based BFT protocols generally assume a static set of processes, whereas deployed systems must occasionally add or remove nodes in response to operational demands. Existing solutions are not seamless; they either pause the system or delay membership changes until a predetermined epoch boundary. This may be impractical and can introduce downtime. However, a seamless solution is non-trivial; agreement on when to start utilizing a new configuration may yield a logical round number that was already surpassed by the concurrent asynchronous dissemination. In this work, we present a seamless reconfiguration protocol for asynchronous DAG-based Byzantine atomic broadcast. Our protocol allows the DAG to continue growing while the membership and corresponding quorum thresholds change, without halting the system. To the best of our knowledge, ours is the first protocol to provide seamless reconfiguration for DAG-based Byzantine atomic broadcast in a fully asynchronous network.

papers.title: A Systematization of Knowledge on DeFi Vaults: Architectures, Curation Mechanisms, and Strategy Design
papers.abstractOneWord: 系统化梳理 DeFi 金库架构、策展控制平面与策略失败模式，刻画委托风险。无 LLM。
papers.abstract: 去中心化金融（DeFi）金库是基于智能合约的资产管理系统：汇集存款、执行可编程策略，并铸造代表对底层资产与策略表现之主张的代币化份额。随着金库设计从早期收益聚合器演进到模块化、主动管理的系统，出现了新的控制层——策展（curation）：选择策略、配置风险参数并协调运维执行，从而引入委托—代理动态与新的失败模式。本文通过以下方式系统化 DeFi 金库架构与策展中介的控制平面：（i）统一系统模型，以及份额会计、角色与运维依赖的形式化定义；（ii）三套互补分类法，分别覆盖金库敞口与目标、策展治理与问责机制，以及策略执行模式及其失败模式。作者进一步把一批代表性生产协议映射到这些维度。该框架旨在支持对区块链金融应用的严格分析与更安全的设计。
papers.abstractEn: Decentralized finance (DeFi) vaults are smart-contract-based asset management systems that pool deposits, execute programmable strategies, and mint tokenized shares representing claims on underlying assets and strategy performance. As vault designs have evolved from early yield aggregators to modular, actively managed systems, a new control layer, curation, has emerged to select strategies, configure risk parameters, and coordinate operational execution, introducing principal-agent dynamics and new failure modes. This paper systematizes DeFi vault architectures and curator-mediated control planes through (i) a unified system model and formal definitions for share accounting, roles, and operational dependencies, and (ii) three complementary taxonomies covering vault exposures and objectives, curator governance and accountability mechanisms, and strategy execution patterns together with their failure modes. We further map a representative set of production protocols to the proposed dimensions. The frameworks in this work aim to support rigorous analysis and safer design of blockchain-based financial applications.

papers.title: Batch Decryption from New Standard Assumptions
papers.abstractOneWord: 为加密内存池设计可批解密方案，使权威可用短密钥授权解密一批密文。无 LLM。
papers.abstract: 批解密允许权威发布一把短密钥，使被选中的一批密文可以被公开解密。受加密内存池启发，本文通过两种具有不同授权语义与假设的构造来研究这一能力。第一，给出基于 Fiat 的 Batch RSA（CRYPTO'89）的简单紧凑无纪元构造，工作在 RSA 群上。其批解密提示只是一个群元素，密钥与密文大小与批大小无关，且建立时不必固定批次上界。作者在随机预言机模型下、在强 RSA 假设下证明自适应安全。该方案允许对重叠批次重复发布，每次发布授权解密被选中的密文。第二，给出纪元模型下带批解密的基于身份加密的自适应安全通用构造，挑战纪元至多允许一次批密钥查询。该构造结合通过乱码电路的延迟加密、具有非包含安全的基于注册加密，以及弱接收者非承诺 IBE。后者由普通 IBE 与伪随机函数构造，从而使纪元构造可在计算 Diffie–Hellman 假设下实例化。
papers.abstractEn: Batch decryption allows an authority to release a short key that enables public decryption of a selected batch of ciphertexts. Motivated by encrypted mempools, we study this capability through two constructions with different authorization semantics and assumptions. First, we provide a simple and compact epochless construction in an RSA group based on Fiat's Batch RSA [CRYPTO'89]. Its batch-decryption hint is just one group element, and its keys and ciphertexts have size independent of the batch size, with no batch bound fixed at setup. We prove adaptive security under the strong RSA assumption in the random-oracle model. The scheme permits repeated releases for overlapping batches, with each release authorizing decryption of the selected ciphertexts. Second, we give an adaptively secure generic construction of identity-based encryption with batch decryption in the epoch-based model, which permits at most one batch-key query for the challenge epoch. The construction combines deferred encryption via garbled circuits, non-inclusion secure registration-based encryption, and weak receiver non-committing IBE. We construct the latter primitive from ordinary IBE and pseudorandom functions, obtaining an instantiation of the epoch-based construction from the computational Diffie--Hellman assumption.

papers.title: Threshold Key Encapsulation Mechanisms via MPC: ML-KEM Compatibility and Optimization
papers.abstractOneWord: 优化与 ML-KEM 兼容的 MPC 门限封装解密轮数，面向门限钱包与多方密钥。无 LLM。
papers.abstract: 目前对与标准兼容的门限密码原语兴趣很高，NIST 多方门限方案征集（NIST IR 8214C）进一步推动了这一趋势。虽然可用多方计算（MPC）从 NIST 标准 ML-KEM 构造门限密钥封装机制（KEM）以保持与 ML-KEM 的兼容，但直接构造的门限解封装轮数很高，ML-KEM-512 可达 384 轮。本文优化基于 MPC 的门限 ML-KEM 解封装轮复杂度。第一种构造（方案 A）使用掩码谓词、并行硬币扩展与全局调度，在保持 ML-KEM 封装、公钥与密文格式的同时降低轮数；对 ML-KEM-512、768 与 1024，轮数分别降到 145、218 与 290。第二种变体（方案 B）使用对 MPC 友好的 Kyber KEM 变体与 KangarooTwelve 哈希，在 ML-KEM-512 安全级别把轮数进一步降到 35，但不再完全兼容 ML-KEM。在半诚实 MPC 模型中，作者通过与 ML-KEM 的精确组合证明方案 A 的安全性，并在 QROM 中由 Module-LWE 与可忽略解密失败证明方案 B 的 IND-CCA 安全。
papers.abstractEn: There is currently a strong interest in designing standard-compatible threshold cryptographic primitives, a trend bolstered by NIST's Call for Multi-Party Threshold Schemes (NIST IR 8214C). While Multi-Party Computation (MPC) can be applied to the construction of threshold Key Encapsulation Mechanism (KEM) from NIST standard ML-KEM scheme to preserve the compatibility with ML-KEM, such a direct construction yields a high number of threshold decapsulation rounds as many as 384 for MK-KEM-512. In this paper, we optimise the round complexity of MPC-based threshold ML-KEM decapsulation. Our first construction (Scheme A) uses masked predicates, parallel coin expansion and global scheduling methods to improve the round complexity of MPC-based ML-KEM decapsulation, while maintaining ML-KEM encapsulation, public key and ciphertext formats. For ML-KEM-512, 768 and 1024, our construction improves the round complexity to 145, 218, and 290, respectively. We also introduce a variant (Scheme B) that uses an MPC-friendly variant of Kyber KEM and KangarooTwelve hash to further improve the round complexity to 35 at the security level of ML-KEM-512, without full ML-KEM compatibility. In the semi-honest MPC model, we prove Scheme A security by exact composition with ML-KEM, and Scheme B IND-CCA security in the QROM from Module-LWE and negligible decryption failure.
